analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 37.2, entering oversold territory, with 5 consecutive down closes. ADX at 17.6 indicates weak trend strength. MACD histogram continues to worsen. Volume ratio at 1.74x (5-day avg) shows surge but price decline reduces reliability. 52-week position at 76.1% indicates over 10% drop from highs. Aligns with market-wide shift to 'risk management' on Nov 2nd. Current price $67.02 nears swing support at $66.94.
